why: This one is contested. Two major reviewers cover the question in part. Macworld has reviewed car charger picks (Pitaka MagEZ Pro 2, ESR Qi2), but they sit inside a broader MagSafe charger guide. WIRED gives one car mount pick in its general MagSafe charger gallery, and Tom's Guide only covers car phone mounts in general. None of them runs a dedicated test of car mount chargers. The rest are niche sites that partly test or score on specs (Dash & Drive, The Gadgeteer, izreview, mountguys) and a group of near-identical Amazon-widget roundups (itechguides, rottenwifi, carcody). A focused page could get in, but it would be up against the Macworld and WIRED names.
